negative_reviews.author: cc z
negative_reviews.text: Make me pay before giving out the bill, very unprofessional. Not impressed, definitely not worth the 10% service fee, which was added to the bill.

negative_reviews.author: Sam Tran
negative_reviews.text:
If you’re after decent food this place is a good bet. However, if you’re looking for a genuine good experience you’ll be disappointed.
The setting is nice and the music playlist is well put together but that’s about it.

The Ton Kotsu was delicious and worth ordering.
The pumpkin croquettes were oddly oily.
The Chicken Katsu Curry was pretty standard but it was nice. A miso soup was supposed to complement the curry but we didn’t realise it until after the meal and we mentioned it.  No apology was given and we left feeling like we were at fault and there was no accountability from the team.
The customer service was terrible.

Organisation and communication definitely aren’t their strong suits and I’m still trying to figure out what they are.
Surprisingly, they cooperated with some free meals after we mentioned we waited over 30 minutes as per the lunch deal policy. That certainly softened the blow.

I love Japanese food and culture, but this was far from it. And you should stay far from it also.

negative_reviews.author: Joanna Carlos
negative_reviews.text:
The food is satisfactory, because it was far far more tastier and creamier before than today. It is still tasty and far better than the others out there.
Atmosphere today too is a bit not conducive for eating because the other table’s children are all around out table.
Service though of Giovana is brilliant. She has accomodated us very kindly and entertained our concern on time and acted immediately. She was all helpful all throughout the meal.
Kudos to the chef as well for dealing with the order that we had issue about.
Overall, we will still recommend the place and the meal. We will still come back for more.

negative_reviews.author: Aliasger Bharmal
negative_reviews.text:
Giovana was very welcoming and clearly explained the menu. Took into account of our allergies and always had a pleasant smile.

The restaurant has a pleasant atmosphere.

negative_reviews.author: Aris Alcantara
negative_reviews.text: They promised that if we don’t get our food within 30 minutes it will be free already. Our takoyaki didn’t come even before we had our bill. That’s a total of more than 1hour of wait. Nobody even apologised or acknowledged that the service/food was late. The waiters were very passive. No urgency at all! So disgusting, specially that we are celebrating a special occasion today. So disappointing.
